key_idea: Follow each path arrow by arrow and stop if it lands on water.
steps: The fox starts in the top left corner. The hen is in the bottom right corner.
The water is on the 3rd square of the top row, the last square of the middle row and the 2nd square of the bottom row.
Path A goes down, right, right, down, right. The fox walks along the middle row to the 3rd square, steps down, then goes right to the hen.
None of those squares has water.

choice_feedback.B: After 2 jumps right, the fox is on the water in the top row.
choice_feedback.C: Down, down, right puts the fox on the water in the bottom row.
choice_feedback.D: Down, right, down puts the fox on the water in the bottom row.
choice_feedback.E: Right, down, down puts the fox on the water in the bottom row.
